sections.Profile:
The Tropic Isle pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in April 1962, was designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. Featuring a tropical island theme, it includes two flippers, four pop bumpers, and a standout backbox animation where monkeys climb a tree, awarding replays as they reach the top.
